issues.where: the bursting bubble crown on the left and the large dome bubble on the right
issues.what: the bursting bubble reads as a stiff, papery translucent geometric crown with sharp triangular peaks, while the large dome has a plastic specular highlight, blotchy stretched texture, and a hard dark cutout rim where it meets the surface
issues.fix: give the burst irregular wet fluid filaments and refractive droplets, blend the bubble base smoothly into the liquid with a meniscus, and reflect the overcast sky across the dome

issues.where: the rain curtain in the upper right sky
issues.what: the distant rain shaft reads as a flat dome-shaped card of uniform vertical dark streaks floating in the mist without a natural cloud base
issues.fix: connect the rain shaft to a darker overcast cloud deck with irregular wind-sheared density and softer atmospheric falloff

issues.where: the shallow red puddles on the central salt bar (left crop, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the puddles appear as flat matte-pink solid-color patches with crisp mask edges, showing no depth, no sky reflection, and no darkened wet rim on the surrounding salt
issues.fix: add grazing-angle sky reflection, subtle depth variation, and a damp darkened wick zone into the adjacent salt crust

issues.where: the red brine channels and pools across the foreground and midground
issues.what: the liquid reads as opaque uniform muddy-red paint that barely reflects the bright overcast sky or the stalks standing in it, with dry abrupt edges against the salt flat
issues.fix: increase Fresnel reflection of the overcast sky and nearby reeds, add subtle depth and meniscus contact, and darken wet salt margins

issues.where: the salt-encrusted carcasses and cracked salt flat (right crop, x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the crusty white mounds look soft and sculpted like clay with smooth untextured white spines sticking out without shadows, over soft-edged ground cracks with flat painted red patches
issues.fix: add crisp crystalline salt micro-detail and contact occlusion to the carcasses, texture and shadow the spines, and sharpen the cracked salt-plate relief

issues.where: the foreground salt crust and protruding shards (right crop, x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the foreground bank looks soft and clay-like up close, and sharp faceted brown triangular spikes poke cleanly out of the fluid with no wet edge or surface detail
issues.fix: replace the faceted spikes with detailed irregular mineral formations, sharpen the foreground salt displacement, and add wet darkening along the waterline

issues.where: the brine surface and pale foam patches (left crop, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the liquid surface is overly smooth and blurry with soft-edged flat grey-white noise blotches instead of fine bubbly foam and crisp ripples
issues.fix: add cellular bubble structure to the foam and sharper fine-scale capillary ripples catching the sky light

issues.where: the white moth-like insects on the foreground stalk (left crop, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the insects read as flat untextured translucent cutouts with no body detail or contact shadows, and the lower insect wing clips into the stalk ring
issues.fix: add modeled bodies, legs, and subtle wing texture, keep the wings clear of the stalk geometry, and cast soft contact shadows onto the bark

issues.where: the water droplets on the red plumes and the bubbles in the pool behind the stalks
issues.what: the droplets look like uniform glass marbles stuck to the fronds rather than surface-tension water beads, and the background bubbles show the same hard dark-rimmed plastic dome look
issues.fix: vary droplet size and elongate them along the needles with wet sheen on the fronds, and blend the background bubbles into the water with proper meniscus and sky reflection

issues.where: the airborne spray near the foreground stalk (top-left crop, x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: spray droplets read as small dark blurred dots with soft halos rather than bright refractive liquid droplets
issues.fix: render airborne spray as varied refractive droplets catching the overcast sky light

issues.where: the foreground stalks entering the water (bottom-right crop, x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the stalks enter the red brine with no wet meniscus or clear reflection, and the bent middle stalk shows an abrupt geometric kink
issues.fix: smooth the bent stalk curvature and add wet base darkening, a subtle meniscus, and water reflection at the entry points
